big_case.notes: Section 11(a) misleading-omissions standard for interim financial data in IPO registration statements: a CVSG'd, SG/SEC-supported circuit conflict following Macquarie, with real consequences for issuers, underwriters and securities-class-action practice, and Chamber/SIFMA/WLF amicus interest. Technical statutory securities case with little public salience beyond the capital-markets bar; the grant is limited to one question and leaves the Item 303 theory alone.
